postconditions: Godray shader uniform reflects new exposure value

action.code: const colorInput = document.querySelector('input[type="color"]'); if(colorInput) { colorInput.value = '#ff8844'; colorInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Godray tint color changed to warm orange

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const decaySlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.parentElement.textContent.includes('Decay') || s.id.includes('decay')); if(decaySlider) { decaySlider.value = 0.88; decaySlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const dissolveSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.parentElement.textContent.includes('Dissolve') || s.id.includes('dissolve')); if(dissolveSlider) { dissolveSlider.value = 0.5; dissolveSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Rune patterns partially visible through dungeon walls

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const dissolveSlider = Array.from(sliders).find(s => s.parentElement.textContent.includes('Dissolve') || s.id.includes('dissolve')); if(dissolveSlider) { dissolveSlider.value = 1.0; dissolveSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }
